title: Audit Writer Migration Readiness & Trusted Context Gate
method: Static source scan. Context signals are not proof of trusted context at each call site.

policy.convertOnlyWhen: A validated organization/tenant context is derived from authenticated membership and explicitly passed to recordForTenant().
policy.systemEvents: System events need an explicit trusted tenant scope or a deliberately designed global-event policy; do not use a fake actor/tenant.
